title: Pork and Dumplings Italian Stew
description: A hearty Italian-inspired stew made with pork and dumplings, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
While the stew is cooking, prepare the dumplings according to the package instructions.
Add the cooked dumplings to the stew and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
